descripcion: Tercera puerta del vertical slice. NO entrega ninguna prueba: siembra un dato raro que el jugador todavía no puede usar. Así se enseña que no todo lo que oyes sirve hoy. | Lleva un nodo de LLAMADA delante: antes la escena se abria con el vecino contestando a una pregunta que nadie habia hecho.
_guion: Texto del Guion jugable del Acto I.

knock.texto: Good evening. Has anyone in your house been ill?

greeting.texto: No one in this house, Reverend. Not yet. But I see everything from this window.

opciones.texto: Who has been carried out of this street?

sacados.texto: George Carr from number 38, on Friday night. And the tailor's boy at 39, Albert Keys. They carried him out before dawn the same day.

the_brewery.texto: The brewery on Broad Street. Seventy men work there, in the same air as us. I have not seen one of them carried out.

opciones.texto: Who has been carried out of this street?

closing.texto: Try the tailor at 39. He has not opened his door since Friday.

otra_vez.texto: I have told you what I saw, Reverend. I have washing to do.

_guia: No nombra la bomba (señalaría al culpable). Cierra nombrando el 39.
_pivote: Da el nombre del aprendiz del 39: esa ficha se completa cruzando dos puertas.
